non_leakage_statement: Reads only official Strict-Small training text. No official AoA/CDI words, child curves, AoA outputs, SuperGLUE labels, or downstream evaluation results are read or used.

intended_controls.true_cluster: same-block shared-anchor complementary official sentences packed into one local row
intended_controls.anchor_only_shuffle: keep source, length and anchor frequency but replace one sentence with a same-anchor sentence from another block when possible
intended_controls.original_repeat: repeat one anchor sentence or an equal-length excerpt to match anchor/mask exposure
intended_controls.untouched_order: same sentence inventory left in its original corpus positions
